tools.timeZones.metadata.title: World Time Zones | Tools
tools.timeZones.metadata.description: Live world map of time zones with the current local time and UTC offset in every IANA time zone.
tools.timeZones.title: World Time Zones
tools.timeZones.lead: The current local time and UTC offset across the world. Times come from your browser's copy of the IANA Time Zone Database, so daylight saving changes are applied automatically.
tools.timeZones.clocks.heading: Current time
tools.timeZones.clocks.yourZoneUnknown: Your browser did not report a time zone.
tools.timeZones.map.heading: Time zone map
tools.timeZones.map.ariaLabel: Time zones on the world map
tools.timeZones.map.instructions: Each dot marks a time zone's principal city, colored by its current UTC offset. Hover, tap or focus a dot to see its details. When the map has keyboard focus, the arrow keys move from west to east between zones.
tools.timeZones.map.error: The map could not load. The list of time zones below still works.
tools.timeZones.map.legend.label: UTC offset color scale
tools.timeZones.details.heading: Selected zone
tools.timeZones.details.unknownZone: Your browser's time zone database does not include this zone, so its time cannot be shown.
tools.timeZones.table.heading: All time zones
tools.timeZones.table.caption: Current local time, UTC offset and daylight saving status for each time zone
tools.timeZones.table.searchHint: Search by city, zone, region, name or offset, such as +5:30.
tools.timeZones.table.unsupported.one: {count} zone is not in your browser's time zone database and is not listed.
tools.timeZones.table.unsupported.other: {count} zones are not in your browser's time zone database and are not listed.
tools.timeZones.attribution.heading: Data sources
tools.timeZones.attribution.sources: Land outline: {naturalEarth} (public domain). Zone locations: {iana} (public domain).
tools.timeZones.attribution.times: Times, offsets and zone names come from your browser's copy of the IANA Time Zone Database.
